project: Analysing and Predicting Material Asset-Allocation Transitions among Retirement Benefits Schemes in Kenya
target_definition: A material change is an absolute change of at least five percentage points in at least one individual asset-class share between consecutive reporting years.
aggregation_note: All dashboard datasets are aggregate summaries. No scheme reference identifiers or row-level scheme observations are exported. Asset shares are unweighted averages across schemes in each reporting year.
shap_note: SHAP values describe the underlying base classifier before the separate sigmoid calibration layer. They are not causal effects or changes in calibrated probability.
